source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: When the Leman Russ Commander’s unit is destroyed in the opponent’s [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), roll one D6 before resolving **[Deadly Demise](vsdata:core-ability/deadly-demise)**. On 2+, leave it on the battlefield. It can shoot only at its attacker, after the attacker shoots. Resolve **[Deadly Demise](vsdata:core-ability/deadly-demise)** and remove the wreck after it shoots or when the phase ends, whichever happens first.

detail.trigger: destroyed in enemy Shooting phase before resolving Deadly Demise

onSuccess.complete: resolve DEADLY DEMISE and remove after this unit shoots or at phase end, whichever occurs first
